{{Top|leg}}
The '''Technology Sector''', commonly referred to as '''TechSec''', was the '''North Pole''' of [[Centerpoint Station]]. It was named as such due to the presence of nearly two dozen high-tech manufacturing companies' facilities that occupied the pole. It was joined to the central sphere at the [[Northern Docking Zone]].
